settings.headline: Tell me about your land or house
settings.subtitle: Email is the fastest way to reach me. The .example address does not reach anyone, and this demo has no contact or payment forms.

items.name: New projects
items.note: New homes, ADUs and remodels. I reply within two working days — myself, not an assistant.

items.name: Feasibility questions
items.note: Can this lot take an ADU? Remodel or rebuild? Start here.

items.name: Current clients
items.note: Or use your client portal, where your drawings and updates live.

items.name: Journal and talks
items.note: Questions about an article, or a talk for your group.

settings.headline: What helps me reply quickly
settings.body:
• The address, or a few photos of the land or house
  • What you hope the project makes possible
  • Your rough timeline
  • Anything already drawn, surveyed or permitted

I reply with questions and, if it looks like a fit, a time to walk it together.
settings.side: Monday to Thursday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm CT. Fridays are site days, so expect replies on Monday.
